safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting documentation that the patient denies chest pain minimally affects assessment in this presentation (primary complaint is lower abdominal pain), and other key cardiopulmonary negatives are captured. This is largely a completeness/medico-legal ROS issue with low likelihood of changing management here.
